_notes: foil_gold/foil_silver/shiny_panels follow the established Rosetta/M4V naming convention. tex_01.stl was visually inspected and shows four square panels in a clear X/cross layout around a central drum, matching NEAR Shoemaker's real four fixed solar panels, so it was classified as solar_panel alongside shiny_panels.
_unmapped_note: No separate bus geometry. foil_gold.stl (40.3%) IS the octagonal bus, modelled as its gold MLI covering and mapped to Gold MLI. Splitting structure from covering is not possible from this CAD.
